parameters.query: SELECT p.id, p.numero_pedido, p.valor_total, p.cliente_id, p.forma_pagamento, p.itens, p.endereco_entrega, c.nome AS cliente_nome, c.telefone AS cliente_telefone, pz.gateway_pagamento, pz.asaas_api_key, pz.mp_access_token, pz.nome AS pizzaria_nome, pz.instancia FROM public.pedidos p JOIN public.clientes c ON c.id = p.cliente_id JOIN public.pizzarias pz ON pz.id = p.pizzaria_id WHERE p.id = $1 AND p.pizzaria_id = $2 LIMIT 1;
UPDATE public.pedidos SET payment_id = $1, link_pagamento = $2, payment_status = 'pending', updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = $3 RETURNING id;

UPDATE public.pedidos SET payment_status = $1, status = CASE WHEN $1 = 'approved' THEN 'confirmado' ELSE status END, updated_at = NOW() WHERE (id::text = $2 OR payment_id = $3) RETURNING id, pizzaria_id, cliente_id, numero_pedido, valor_total, status, payment_status, (SELECT telefone FROM public.clientes WHERE id = pedidos.cliente_id) AS cliente_telefone, (SELECT instancia FROM public.pizzarias WHERE id = pedidos.pizzaria_id) AS instancia, (SELECT mensagens_status FROM public.pizzarias WHERE id = pedidos.pizzaria_id) AS mensagens_status;
